statement: Preliminary triage SUGGESTION to help a clinician decide what to look at first. It is not a diagnosis and not a validated clinical risk score. Every number below is a product setting chosen for this prototype — NOT a clinical threshold — and has not been medically validated.

slm.note: The language model may only ESCALATE. It can never lower or remove a deterministic warning-sign flag.

reasons.rule_urgent: A deterministic warning-sign rule matched: {label}. Needs prompt clinician review.
reasons.model_flag: The language model described a possible warning sign: {label}. Verify against the original text.
reasons.model_flag_unverified: The language model described a possible warning sign ({label}) but its quote could not be matched to the original text; treated as Priority until a clinician checks.
reasons.model_priority: The language model suggested higher attention: {rationale}
reasons.conflict: Patient statement and report (or two statements) disagree — needs clarification.
reasons.uncertain: Some information is unclear (transcription, translation or report reading) — needs clarification.
reasons.suspicious: The patient text contains an instruction aimed at the system. It was ignored, but the case needs a human look.
reasons.incomplete: Key details are missing (completeness {completeness}%, below the configured {threshold}% threshold).
reasons.no_ai: Automatic extraction was limited, so a person should confirm the details.
reasons.routine: No warning-sign rule matched, key details are present and nothing conflicts. Preliminary only — a clinician decides.
